instruction:
Turn this image into an editable PPT, not an image.
Also make the following adjustments:
1. Replace the word “assessment” in the second section of the image with “check”.
2. Replace the content in the “finish” section of the image with The site was back up and stable within 10 minutes, order submissions resumed, and a post-incident review has been scheduled for 4:00 PM this afternoon.

dim1: The deliverable is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened normally.
The delivered PPT contains 1 slide that presents the flowchart.
The slide is not one single image.
dim2: +5: Overall composition of slide 1: The page fully displays 5 stage nodes, the legend at the top, horizontal action arrows, the emotion dashed line at the bottom, 4 words, and the theme text at the bottom. The overall width occupies 85%-96% of the page width, and the height occupies 75%-90% of the page height.

+3: Legend box in the upper-left corner of slide 1: Located in the upper-left corner of the page, 0.4-0.7 cm from the top edge and 0.6-0.8 cm from the left edge; 5.5-5.9 cm wide and 2.2-2.4 cm high; white fill; dark blue rounded-rectangle border; contains a 2.2-2.4 cm long black solid-line arrow with the text “action” and a 2.2-2.4 cm long orange dashed-line arrow with the text “emotion.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 14-18 points.

+5: Stage 1 node on slide 1: Located in the area from the upper-left to the upper-center of the page, 3.5-3.8 cm from the top edge; includes a 1-1.2 cm wide and high circle with dark green fill and the white number “1”; the number is white; a 3.1-3.4 cm wide and high light blue circle containing a computer warning icon; a 4-4.2 cm wide and 0.9-1.1 cm high dark teal rounded title bar labeled “start,” with bold white Arial or Times New Roman text at 14-18 points; and, below it, a 5.1-5.3 cm wide and 4.3-4.6 cm high white description box. The description box text is “At 8:40 a.m., the team noticed that the online store was no longer loading for customers.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 10-14 points.

+5: On slide 1, the stage 2 node: Located to the right of stage 1; includes a 1-1.2 cm wide and high circle with dark green fill and the white number “2”; the number is white; a 3.1-3.4 cm wide and high light blue circle containing a magnifying-glass icon; a small orange circular badge with an exclamation mark; a 4-4.2 cm wide and 0.9-1.1 cm high dark teal rounded title bar labeled “check,” with bold white Arial or Times New Roman text at 14-18 points; and, below it, a 5.1-5.3 cm wide and 4.3-4.6 cm high rounded-rectangle description box with light blue fill. The description box text is “The support lead checked alerts, confirmed the outage, and opened an incident channel for developers and operations.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 10-14 points.

+5: On slide 1, the stage 3 node: Located in the middle of the page; includes a 1-1.2 cm wide and high circle with dark green fill and the white number “3”; the number is white; a 3.1-3.4 cm wide and high light blue circle containing a server warning icon; a 4-4.2 cm wide and 0.9-1.1 cm high dark teal rounded title bar labeled “problem peak,” with bold white Arial or Times New Roman text at 14-18 points; and, below it, a 5.1-5.3 cm wide and 4.3-4.6 cm high rounded-rectangle description box with light blue fill. The description box text is “Orders failed repeatedly because the database connection pool was exhausted during the launch traffic surge.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 10-14 points.

+5: On slide 1, the stage 4 node: Located to the right of stage 3; includes a 1-1.2 cm wide and high circle with dark green fill and the white number “4”; a 3.1-3.4 cm wide and high light blue circle containing a cloud-and-checkmark icon; a 4-4.2 cm wide and 0.9-1.1 cm high dark teal rounded title bar labeled “solution point,” with bold white Arial or Times New Roman text at 14-18 points; and, below it, a 5.1-5.3 cm wide and 4.3-4.6 cm high rounded-rectangle description box with light blue fill. The description box text is “The team rolled back the latest configuration and switched traffic to a healthy backup instance.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 10-14 points.

+5: On slide 1, the stage 5 node: Located on the right side of the page; includes a 1-1.2 cm wide and high dark-green-filled numbered circle labeled “5”; a 3.1-3.4 cm wide and high light blue circle containing a monitor-and-checkmark icon; a 4-4.2 cm wide and 0.9-1.1 cm high dark teal rounded title bar labeled “finish,” with bold white Arial or Times New Roman text at 14-18 points; and, below it, a 5.1-5.3 cm wide and 4.3-4.6 cm high rounded-rectangle description box with light blue fill. The description box text is “The site was back up and stable within 10 minutes, order submissions resumed, and a post-incident review has been scheduled for 4:00 PM this afternoon.” The text uses Arial or Times New Roman at 10-14 points.
+1: The numbers “1,” “2,” “3,” “4,” and “5” use bold white Arial or Times New Roman at 18-22 points and are horizontally centered.

+1: On slide 1, the main action arrows: Between stages 1 through 5, 4 black horizontal single-headed arrows are placed, all pointing from left to right, with a line width of 1.0-1.5 points and a length of 2.5-2.7 cm. The arrows connect the icon areas of adjacent stages.

+3: Emotion dashed line on slide 1: An orange dashed polyline arrow is placed in the lower part of the page. From left to right, it proceeds diagonally down and to the right for 2.8-3.1 cm, then diagonally up and to the right for 8.5-8.7 cm, then diagonally down and to the right for 6.3-6.6 cm, then diagonally up and to the right for 5.1-5.5 cm, then diagonally down and to the right for 2.3-2.5 cm, and ends with an arrow running diagonally up and to the right for 6.3-6.6 cm. The line width is 1.0-1.5 points, and the dashed-line style is clear.

+1: Emotion labels on slide 1: “concerned,” “tense and focused,” “hopeful,” and “relieved” appear in sequence at the bottom, using Times New Roman or an equivalent Latin font at 12-14 points, in orange and italic, positioned near the dashed line.

+1: Theme text at the bottom of slide 1: “theme: managing a website outage before a product launch” appears at the bottom center of the page, using Times New Roman or an equivalent Latin font at 14-16 points, in blue and italic, and horizontally centered.

+3: Icon style on slide 1: All 5 stage icons are editable icons or combinations of shapes and must not be bitmaps cropped from the original image. The icons primarily use dark teal, light blue, orange, and green.
+1: Background of slide 1: The page background is white or very pale grayish white, with no image watermark, screenshot border, red annotation, or irrelevant decoration.
+3: Editability of slide 1: The user can individually select and modify each stage title, the body text in each description box, each number, each icon, each arrow, and the emotion line.
